title: Frostkiss Ale
summary: Use as 4 Camp Supplies, drink to gain Alcohol, or throw to create a flammable surface.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle and gain Alcohol for 2 turns, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent Alcohol surface in a 13 ft radius. Fire ignites the surface and Cold freezes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
